prompt: Create a dramatic editorial collage in a widescreen 16:9 format about classical music being rediscovered through modern listening. On the left, show a large black-and-white close-up portrait of a silver-haired middle-aged male music critic resembling Rick Beato wearing large metallic over-ear headphones, eyes closed in emotional concentration, one hand touching the left earcup. In the center-right, create a surreal spiral made from exactly one continuous piano keyboard, curling like a ribbon or vortex from the lower foreground up and around a circular medallion. Inside the medallion, place a monochrome engraved portrait of Johannes Brahms with beard and formal 19th-century clothing. On the far right, include exactly one glossy black grand piano with its lid open, visible strings, soundboard, and keyboard angled toward the viewer. Add exactly two white audio waveform graphics: one vertical waveform behind the listener on the far left and one horizontal waveform crossing near the composer portrait. Use a high-contrast graphic magazine-cover style mixing grayscale photography, halftone dots, ink texture, and pop-art shapes. Background colors should be deep black, dark purple, off-white, and acid yellow-green, with circular blocks and dotted halftone gradients. Keep the composition cinematic, layered, energetic, and sophisticated, with sharp detail on the headphones, piano keys, and grand piano interior. No visible headline, captions, logos, watermarks, or extra text. Use acid yellow-green as the dominant pop accent and awed, emotional, transcendent as the facial and musical atmosphere.
